name: claude-skills

plugins.name: clean-style
plugins.description: Apply a strict anti-AI-slop writing checklist to external-facing prose. The shared baseline other skills in this repo defer to.

plugins.name: use-cases
plugins.description: Standalone use case skill: scope a feature into candidate use cases, then write each one in full (actors, basic/alternate/exception paths, post-conditions) in one fixed format. No other skills required.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Seven skills covering an initiative's full lifecycle: Working Backwards PR/FAQ, use-case discovery, UML use cases, test cases, trackable requirements, persona-driven architecture review, and a claude-build implementation plan. Install the bundle, or any one skill on its own.

plugins.name: working-backwards-prfaq
plugins.description: Generate Amazon-style Working Backwards PR/FAQ documents for any kind of announcement: a new product, a partnership, a nonprofit initiative, a political campaign, a community program, or anything else defined by starting from the audience's experience and working backwards.

plugins.name: use-case-discovery
plugins.description: Interview the user about a feature or initiative at a high level and decompose it into a candidate list of use cases (name, one-line summary, rough actors, rough trigger) before any of them get fully written up.

plugins.name: use-case-uml
plugins.description: Write UML-style integration use cases (actors, basic path, alternate paths, exception paths, post-conditions) in a fixed, repeatable structure.

plugins.name: use-case-test-cases
plugins.description: Generate test cases directly from a UML-style use case (written with the use-case-uml skill or in that same format): one test case per Basic Path, Alternate Path, and Exception Path, with expected results taken from the use case's Post-Condition(s).

plugins.name: use-case-requirements
plugins.description: Derive trackable functional requirements, either from a completed use case (written with the use-case-uml skill) or, when no use case exists yet, from a short interview modeled on working-backwards-prfaq's intake.

plugins.name: architect-review
plugins.description: Produce a structured architectural recommendation for an initiative, from the perspective of a specific Sr.

plugins.name: build-plan
plugins.description: Turn product planning artifacts (use cases, functional requirements, test cases, an architecture review, a PR/FAQ) into an implementation plan that an unattended build can follow: ordered milestones with gates, a task table with a model and effort level for each task, project rules and stop conditions, and the engineering prompt that tells the builder what to read first.

description: Claude Code plugins by Todd Emerson: a writing checklist, a use case skill, and a product-management pipeline from PR/FAQ to a claude-build implementation plan. Install the pipeline as one bundle or any skill on its own.
